lines.en: Rumbles forward, shadows move.

lines.zh: 漂移石中穿行，黑影渐近。
lines.en: Wanders through driftstone, shadow approaches.
Columns shift, predator nears.

lines.zh: 注视地面，寻找猎物踪迹。
lines.en: Stares at ground, hunting prey.

lines.zh: 漂石间移动，静默中狩猎。
lines.en: Moves through driftstones, silent hunt.
Stands still, waiting for prey.
Shadows flicker, waiting target.

lines.zh: 漂石群中游走，悄无声息。
lines.en: Wanders driftstone, silent.
Stares distant, new prey.

lines.zh: 漂石缝隙间穿梭，无声无息。
lines.en: Slides through driftstone, silent.

lines.zh: 我挪动三格石身，无人看见。
lines.en: I shift my three-block body when no one watches.

lines.zh: 我在独石间滑行，悄无声息。
lines.en: I glide among the monoliths in silence.
Black shadow stands, wary.
Stands in driftstone, silent.
Stares distant, patient.
Paces driftstone, watches all.
Stands quietly, idle.
Stands in driftstone, observes.
Pauses in driftstone, waits.
Black shadow stands, silent.
Pauses in driftstone, watches.
Paces driftstone, waits prey.
I stand as a pillar, utterly still.
I wait until you tire of looking.
While watched, I am only stone.

lines.zh: 我压下呼吸，连风都不惊。
lines.en: I stifle my breath, not stirring the wind.
Locks target, eyes glowing.
Stares player, waits kill.

lines.zh: 注视你的那一刻，我成了柱子。
lines.en: The moment I watch you, I become a pillar.

lines.zh: 三格高的柱子，也会看你。
lines.en: A three-block pillar can watch you too.
Staring player, waits opportunity.

lines.zh: 你一看我，我就立成这根柱子。
lines.en: One look from you and I rise into this pillar.
Targets player, ready to attack.
Staring player, waits moment.

lines.zh: 三格高的柱子，只用镐能敲。
lines.en: A three-block pillar; only a pick works.
Staring player, ready to kill.

lines.zh: 我的裂纹正对着你的后颈。
lines.en: My crack lines up with the back of your neck.
The moment you look away, I move.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里看你，不眨眼。
lines.en: I watch through the crack, unblinking.
You look up, and I harden into a pillar.

lines.zh: 我的注视黏在你的后背上。
lines.en: My stare clings to your back.

lines.zh: 我化成柱子，你只能拿镐敲。
lines.en: I become a pillar; only a pick can hurt me.
I aim my pillar tip at you.
One glance at me chills you to the bone.

lines.zh: 我只认一个活物，就是你。
lines.en: I acknowledge one living thing: you.

lines.zh: 我在漂石间看你走过来。
lines.en: I watch you walk in among the drifting stones.
Powers fading...
Vision blurring...
A chip of monolith falls off me.
Strength waning...
Sight blurring...
Pain unbearable...
Vision impaired...
My pillar cracks; no light gets in.

lines.zh: 石屑落下，我的注视晃了。
lines.en: Chips fall; my gaze wavers.

lines.zh: 镐尖咬进我的岩层，很深。
lines.en: The pickaxe bites deep into my rock.
You can't resist its gaze.
Approaching it will make you shiver.
Its presence freezes the air.
Touch it, and you'll turn to stone.

lines.zh: 它注视着你，你感到害怕。
lines.en: It stares at you, and you feel afraid.
Approach it, and you'll lose your mind.

lines.zh: 它的目光能穿透你的灵魂。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces your soul.
Touch it, and you'll be stone.

lines.zh: 它那目光让你感到恐惧。
lines.en: Its gaze fills you with fear.
Its gaze is powerful.
It smashes rocks into rubble.
Rocks are crushed by it.
It crushes all the rocks.

lines.zh: 巨石在它的撞击下碎裂。
lines.en: Large stones crack under its impact.

lines.zh: 它将岩石撞得粉身碎骨。
lines.en: It smashes the rocks to pieces.

lines.zh: 岩石无法阻止它的攻击。
lines.en: Rocks can't stop its attack.
Rocks are shattered by its impact.

lines.zh: 它的力量巨大，岩石如纸。
lines.en: Its power is great, like paper to rocks.
Rocks can't stand its collision.
It collides with rocks, crushing all.

lines.zh: 找到配偶，它变得更强大。
lines.en: Finding a mate makes it stronger.

lines.zh: 它的配偶能让它更强大。
lines.en: Its mate strengthens it.
Its mate doubles its strength.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，它变得更强大。
lines.en: Finding a partner makes it stronger.

lines.zh: 它的配偶是力量的源泉。
lines.en: Its mate is a source of strength.
It protects its mate.

lines.zh: 配偶让它拥有更多力量。
lines.en: Its mate gives it more power.

lines.zh: 它的配偶是它的守护者。
lines.en: Its mate is its guardian.
Finding a partner makes it stronger.

lines.zh: 它的配偶增强它的力量。
lines.en: Its mate enhances its strength.

lines.zh: 沉重的石质躯体掉落大地！
lines.en: The heavy stone body crashes to the ground!

lines.zh: 触感冰冷，仿佛时间静止！
lines.en: Ice-cold, as if time stands still!

lines.zh: 古老的石纹中蕴含力量！
lines.en: Ancient stone patterns hold power!

lines.zh: 独石群中散发诡异气息！
lines.en: Eerie aura emanates from driftstone!
Eyeing you, power awakens!
Gaze at the stone pillar, eternal vigil!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群，静默的守护！
lines.en: Driftstone domain, silent guardian!

lines.zh: 石柱下的秘密，等待揭示！
lines.en: Secrets beneath the pillar await!
Lonely pillar, endless gaze!

lines.zh: 你无法逃离全视者的视线！
lines.en: You can't escape the Overseer's sight!
You step into my domain!
Your presence awakens me!
I sense your soul!
You fall into my sight!

lines.zh: 漂移的独石把我推到这里。
lines.en: The drifting monoliths carried me here.
I stand motionless, waiting for you to strike.
Your life essence calls to me!
You can't escape my gaze!
You become my prey!
You are destined to be observed!
Your footsteps woke me.
Without a raised pickaxe, you cannot leave.
I see you grip the pickaxe.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸落在我石面上。
lines.en: Your breath falls on my stone face.
These drifting stones hold only me.
I turn toward you, almost nodding.
I will gaze upon you!

lines.zh: 我化成了柱子，只等你来挖。
lines.en: I became a pillar, waiting for your pick.

lines.zh: 独石群的低语，就是我的声音。
lines.en: The whisper of the monoliths is my voice.
You will be forever watched!
My gaze will pierce through you!
You will serve me!
My gaze will guide you!
You will be forever bound!

lines.zh: 我的目光将永远笼罩你！
lines.en: My gaze will forever envelop you!
I will always gaze upon you!

lines.zh: 我会一直看，直到你低头。
lines.en: I will watch until you bow your head.
I don't chase, yet you cannot leave.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我钉在岩上。
lines.en: I have nailed your shadow to the rock.
Look at me once more, and you lose.

lines.zh: 我让独石替你合拢成墙。
lines.en: I let the monoliths close into a wall for you.
I don't strike; I wait for you to tire.
When the pickaxe falls silent, I draw near.

lines.zh: 我压住你的退路，三格高。
lines.en: Three blocks tall, I block your way back.

lines.zh: 你一看我，我就僵成石柱。
lines.en: When you look, I stiffen into a stone pillar.

lines.zh: 这片荒原，只留我的注视。
lines.en: This wasteland keeps only my stare.
Sssss, can't move!
Staring at you, tremble!

lines.zh: 镐子以外的刀剑，都滑开了。
lines.en: Swords and axes slide off; only picks bite.
Turn to dust, hope is lost!
Gaze into the abyss, despair devours!

lines.zh: 你触碰了禁忌，痛苦随之！
lines.en: You've touched the taboo, pain follows!

lines.zh: 恐惧中寻求庇护，徒劳无功！
lines.en: Seek shelter in fear, in vain!
You have nowhere to flee!

lines.zh: 你看了我一眼，我就长成柱。
lines.en: One glance and I become a pillar.
Seeking survival in despair, too late!

lines.zh: 我砸下去，尘土埋住脚踝。
lines.en: I slam down; dust buries your ankles.

lines.zh: 我不反击，这一下是警告。
lines.en: I don't fight back; this blow is a warning.

lines.zh: 我的岩面压来，挤走空气。
lines.en: My stone face presses in and squeezes the air out.
I tilt, and rubble falls like rain.

lines.zh: 你的镐崩了口，我毫发无损。
lines.en: Your pickaxe chips; I lose nothing.

lines.zh: 被我看住的猎物，动不了。
lines.en: The prey I watch cannot move.
Spawn in driftstone clusters!
Stalkers, I will appear!
In driftstone, I wait!
Find my gaze!
Awake in driftstone!
Stalkers, prepare!
Return to driftstone!
Spawn in driftstone!
See my power!
Gaze from driftstone!
I push up slowly out of the ground.

lines.zh: 我在荒原上多长出一根柱。
lines.en: I add one more pillar to the wasteland.
The dust settles; I stand three blocks tall.

lines.zh: 我不是怪物，是会看的柱子。
lines.en: I am no monster, but a pillar that watches.

lines.zh: 我在独石群里添了道裂纹。
lines.en: I add a crack to the monoliths.

lines.zh: 我在你背后长成，没有声音。
lines.en: I grow behind you without a sound.
The rock splits; my pillar top emerges.

lines.zh: 漂石聚拢，拼成我的身体。
lines.en: Drifting stones gather into my body.
The wasteland gains one more watching spot.
I rise where no one stands.
Fire leaves black marks on my pillar.
Fall impact...

lines.zh: 我化成柱子，水也只漫到腰。
lines.en: As a pillar, the water only reaches my waist.
Explosion shockwave...
Arrow pierces me...
Magic force...
Starvation erodes me...
Lightning strikes me...
Void devours me...
